findings: The immutable production diff contains none of the six heldout fixture labels or names.
The diff contains no golden/fixture reads, include_str/include_bytes embedding, coordinate or dimension keys, source-line equality branches, entity-name branches, or entity-count ladders.
The only new branch is the Java-image-contract predicate on EntityKind::State and EntityKind::Diamond; this is mechanism-shaped and is supported by EntityImageState and EntityImageBranch.

The durable corrected account 5df5e7ed799d1e2a414751cd6d6c635aeec055ef is an ancestor of immutable implementation 1166e7e3424c0fb976acaddae6f566972f3bd5c9, and the account file is byte-unchanged between them.

The pinned Java checkout and JAR match the requested revision and prior oracle evidence. UGroup(LineLocation) alone inserts DATA_SOURCE_LINE. EntityImageClass, EntityImageObject, and EntityImageDescription use that constructor; EntityImageState and EntityImageBranch create location-free groups.

Within Rust's represented class EntityKind set, entity_group_has_source_line is correct. Four fresh matrices totaling 29 entity groups match Java metadata exactly across aliases, source-line offsets, declaration order, duplicate image contracts, disconnected topology, and all class-like variants.

The exact concrete-image ownership invariant is broader than Rust's current EntityKind set. Java ClassDiagram CommandCreateElementFull2 accepts allowmixing actor, usecase, component, database, queue, node, rectangle, and related symbols as LeafType.DESCRIPTION or LeafType.USECASE; GeneralImageBuilder routes those leaves to EntityImageDescription, which carries their declaration LineLocation.

Rust ClassParser::try_entity_decl accepts only class-like, object, state, circle, and diamond keywords. Actor, usecase, component, and queue declarations are ignored, after which relationship parsing creates implicit EntityKind::Class endpoints at the relationship source line. Bare database, node, and rectangle declarations are parsed as package containers even without braces, distorting both identity and location.

The two description-symbol counterexamples therefore fail at the claimed metadata layer independently of geometry: Java owns source metadata at declaration lines 2-5, while Rust owns it at later relationship lines or under misqualified identities.

This failure is not caused by fixture-shaped code and is not a defect in the new State/Diamond predicate itself. It is a neighboring generative-model gap in allowmixing concrete image/type dispatch. The held-out gate nevertheless rejects the implementation against the stated ownership claim; passing only the currently represented subset is insufficient.

All six fresh sources are valid PlantUML rendered headlessly by the pinned Java JAR, all twelve source/golden files are byte-unique against the existing corpus, xmllint accepts every Java and Rust SVG, and no PlantUML error marker is present.
No Cargo, rustc, rustfmt, or production edit was performed. Existing unrelated renderer edits and sequence perturbations in the shared worktree were neither inspected for acceptance nor staged.
